optimizedDescription.value: Resolve expanded artifact instructions, templates, delta guidance, outlines, and DAG-selected next artifact read-only.

optimizedContext.value:
# Get Artifact Instruction

## Rules

- Constructor: `ChangeRepository`, `ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository>`, `SchemaProvider`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`, `TemplateExpander`.
- `execute(name, artifactId?)`: load change; absent => `ChangeNotFoundError`.
- Resolve schema; `schema.name() !== change.schemaName` => `SchemaMismatchError`.
- Omitted `artifactId`: `evaluateLifecycleVerdict` with empty `checksByTarget`; use topological `nextArtifact`; none => `ArtifactNotFoundError`.
- Find schema artifact `id`; absent => `ArtifactNotFoundError`.
- Expand via `TemplateExpander.expand()`: instruction, template, `deltaInstruction`, rule text.
- Result: `artifactId`; `rulesPre`/`rulesPost` declaration-order instructions, `[]` absent; `instruction`/`template`, `null` absent; `delta`, `null` when `delta: false`.
- Template: read declared path via `SchemaRegistry`; expand content.
- `delta: true`: `formatInstructions = parsers.get(artifact.format).deltaInstructions()`; `domainInstructions = deltaInstruction ?? null`; `availableOutlines`: only `change.specIds` whose artifact file exists in `SpecRepository`.
- Missing parser => `ParserNotRegisteredError`.
- `createGetArtifactInstruction(config, options?)`: derive deps only through `resolveGetArtifactInstructionDeps(resolver)` then canonical `createGetArtifactInstruction(deps)`.
- Helper resolves `changes`, `specs`, `schemaProvider`, `parsers`, `templateExpander`; never `lifecycle`/`LifecycleEngine`; no inline fs wiring.
- Next-artifact/effective-status: `evaluateLifecycleVerdict` empty `checksByTarget`; never hop predicates, `availableTransitions`, global snapshot.

## Constraints

- Read-only: no change mutation or command execution.
- `rules.pre`/`rules.post` augment, never replace instruction.
- Missing delta artifact files silently skipped.
- `availableOutlines` is `string[]` spec IDs only; no outline trees. Fetch on demand: `GetSpecOutline` / `specd specs outline <specPath> --artifact <artifactId>`.
- Caller uses `rulesPre` + instruction + template + `rulesPost` for new artifacts; `rulesPre` + delta + `rulesPost` for deltas.
